issues.title: 产品灵感日报 · 20 个新品

products.name: Toplify
products.tagline: Track your App Store ranking worldwide
products.summaryZh: 追踪你的App Store全球排名
products.descriptionZh: Toplify是一款多服务器服务，全天候监控175个国家/地区的App Store榜单，确保您不会错过下一个里程碑。当排名更新或出现显著跃升时，您会收到提醒。无需API密钥或App Store Connect访问权限。只需添加您的应用，其余交给Toplify处理。
products.description: Toplify is a multi server service monitoring App Store charts across 175 countries, 24/7, so you never miss your next milestone. Get alerts for new rankings and significant jumps. No API keys or App Store Connect access needed. Just add your app and Toplify takes care of the rest.

products.name: Open Analytics
products.tagline: AI-Native Google Analytics alternative for the modern web
products.summaryZh: 面向现代网络的AI原生Google Analytics替代方案
products.descriptionZh: Open Analytics 是一个开源、隐私优先的 Google Analytics 替代方案，专为人类和 AI 代理设计。通过一个轻量级、无 Cookie 的脚本，实时追踪访客、转化漏斗和收入。通过 MCP 将分析数据连接到 AI 工具。符合 GDPR 要求，无需同意横幅，且支持自托管。
products.description: Open Analytics is an open-source, privacy-first alternative to Google Analytics, built for humans and AI agents. Track real-time visitors, funnels, and revenue with one lightweight, cookieless script. Connect your analytics to AI tools via MCP. GDPR-friendly with no consent banner, and self-hostable.

products.name: SubtitleGenerator
products.tagline: From video to publish-ready AI subtitles—all in one browser
products.summaryZh: 从视频到可直接发布的AI字幕——一切尽在浏览器中完成
products.descriptionZh: 免费版：每月60个一分钟视频，无需注册。拖入视频即可在一个编辑器中生成、修正、翻译、美化并导出字幕。全部30种风格均免费包含。多数工具让你逐行查找——修正功能会标记不确定的词语，并倒计时至“全部清晰”，一个真正的终点线。Pro和Max版增加全轨道翻译、无水印高清、八种字幕格式、自定义字体和保存的品牌风格。你的视频始终留在浏览器中。
products.description: Free: 60 one-minute videos a month, no signup. Drop in a video and generate, fix, translate, style and export subtitles in one editor. All 30 styles are included free. Most tools leave you hunting line by line—Fix flags uncertain words and counts down to “All clear,” a real finish line. Pro and Max add full-track translation, HD without a watermark, eight subtitle formats, custom fonts and saved brand styles. Your video stays in your browser.

products.name: Maccess
products.tagline: Your Mac, in your pocket — trackpad, screen, and AI
products.summaryZh: 你的Mac，尽在掌中——触控板、屏幕与AI
products.descriptionZh: 通过触控板、键盘、屏幕镜像、文件和Mackie AI，从iPhone控制你的Mac。可通过Wi-Fi配对，或使用在线访问随时随地连接。
products.description: Control your Mac from iPhone with touchpad, keyboard, screen mirroring, files, and Mackie AI. Pair over Wi-Fi or use Online Access from anywhere.

products.name: AutoClaw
products.tagline: An AI work agent across desktop, browser, and chat
products.summaryZh: 跨桌面、浏览器和聊天界面的AI工作代理
products.descriptionZh: AutoClaw是一款桌面AI代理，用于跨文件、浏览器、办公文档、网络应用和即时通讯的多步骤工作。给它一个目标，让它操作工具并协调代理，然后在同一对话中取回完成的工作。内置GLM-5.3。
products.description: AutoClaw is a desktop AI agent for multi-step work across files, browsers, office documents, web apps, and IM. Give it a goal, let it operate tools and coordinate agents, then get the finished work back in the same conversation. GLM-5.3 is built in.

products.name: Zero
products.tagline: Vercel's programming language built for AI agents
products.summaryZh: Vercel 为 AI 代理构建的编程语言
products.descriptionZh: Zero是Vercel的实验性编程语言，专为AI代理编写代码的世界而设计。代理不再编辑源代码文本，而是查询并修补语义程序图，编译器则检查每一项更改。人类只需提出需求，必要时审阅可读的代码投影。该语言从零开始为代理式编码构建，注重令牌效率、快速构建、低内存占用及零依赖。
products.description: Zero is Vercel's experimental programming language designed for a world where AI agents write the code. Instead of editing source text, agents query and patch a semantic program graph while the compiler checks every change. Humans simply ask for outcomes, then review readable code projections when needed. Built from the ground up for agentic coding, with token efficiency, fast builds, low memory, and zero dependencies.

products.name: Pawvis
products.tagline: Control your Mac via camera & train gestures, local & FOSS
products.summaryZh: 通过摄像头控制你的Mac，并训练手势，本地运行且开源免费。
products.descriptionZh: PawVis将Mac的摄像头变为手势追踪鼠标，无需额外硬件。举手即可移动光标，轻点手指实现点击，双指弯曲进行滚动。可将手势映射至自定义操作，如窗口管理或任意应用/命令，支持常用手势或训练个人手势。所有处理均在设备本地完成，PawVis免费且开源。可选启用语音控制实现免提指令，或将计算机操作任务交给Codex或Claude Code。
products.description: PawVis turns your Mac’s webcam into a hand-tracked mouse, no extra hardware required. Raise your hand and the cursor follows, dip a finger to click, and fold two fingers to scroll. Map gestures to custom actions like window management or any app/command from a series of common gestures or train your own. Everything runs 100% on-device, and PawVis is free and open source. Enable optional voice control for hands-free commands, or pass computer-use tasks to Codex or Claude Code.

products.name: KerasFormers
products.tagline: Keras 3 collection of pretrained models
products.summaryZh: Keras 3 预训练模型集合
products.descriptionZh: 纯Keras 3预训练Transformer模型，可在JAX、PyTorch和TensorFlow上运行。
products.description: Pretrained transformer models in pure Keras 3, runnable on JAX, PyTorch and TensorFlow.

products.name: Agents Never Sleep
products.tagline: Agents keep running with the lid closed
products.summaryZh: 合上盖子后，代理仍会继续运行。
products.descriptionZh: 一款macOS菜单栏应用，即使合上盖子也能保持你的AI代理保持唤醒状态。无需再让笔记本电脑半开或带着它四处走动。停止这种疯狂行为🙅‍♂️，合上盖子吧。
products.description: A macOS menu bar app that keeps your agents AI awake even if with lid closed. No more keeping your laptop half-open or carrying it around in weird ways. Stop this madness 🙅‍♂️, close the lid.

products.name: Port Radar for macOS
products.tagline: An AI port manager for your Mac.
products.summaryZh: 一款适用于Mac的AI端口管理器。
products.descriptionZh: Port Radar 是一款原生 macOS 菜单栏应用，以通俗易懂的方式清晰展示端口上运行的内容。识别 Vite、Next.js、Docker、被遗忘的应用以及其他静默占用资源的程序，一键即可停止。Apple Intelligence 直接在设备上回答“这是什么，停止它是否安全？”，确保信息不离开你的 Mac。此外，一键创建 Cloudflare 隧道，将本地站点分享为实时链接。
products.description: Port Radar is a native macOS menu bar app that shows you exactly what’s running on your ports—in plain English. Spot Vite, Next.js, Docker, forgotten apps, and anything else quietly using resources, then stop it with a single click. Apple Intelligence answers "what is this, is it safe to stop?" right on your device, so nothing leaves your Mac. Plus one click Cloudflare tunnels to share a local site as a live link.

products.name: VeloFiler
products.tagline: Keyboard-first dual-pane file manager for macOS
products.summaryZh: 为macOS设计的键盘优先双窗格文件管理器
products.descriptionZh: VeloFiler 是一款面向 macOS 的键盘优先、双栏文件管理器，基于 Rust 和 GPUI 构建，实现即时启动与流畅渲染。使用 Vim 风格按键导航，无需打开其他应用即可预览图片、代码、Markdown、PDF、视频及 Office 文档，并可通过 SSH/SFTP 在本地文件旁直接管理远程服务器。告别逐层点击文件夹——直接飞越它们。
products.description: VeloFiler is a keyboard-first, dual-pane file manager for macOS, built in Rust on GPUI for instant startup and smooth rendering. Navigate with Vim-style keys, preview images, code, Markdown, PDF, video and Office documents without opening another app, and manage remote servers over SSH/SFTP right next to your local files. Stop clicking through folders — fly through them.

products.name: Pocket by Meta
products.tagline: Vibe-code games, then share them like TikToks
products.summaryZh: 用氛围编码制作游戏，然后像发TikTok一样分享它们。
products.descriptionZh: Pocket是Meta推出的全新社交应用，用于借助AI创建、游玩和混搭互动体验。描述一个想法，将其转化为可玩的“小装置”，它能响应触摸、动作、声音、照片，甚至你的摄像头。分享到信息流，体验他人想象的内容，或将他们的创作混搭成新作品。这是将氛围编程转化为社交体验——无需编写代码。
products.description: Pocket is Meta's new social app for creating, playing, and remixing interactive experiences with AI. Describe an idea and turn it into a playable "gizmo" that can respond to touch, motion, sound, photos, and even your camera. Share it to the feed, play what others have imagined, or remix their creations into something new. It's vibe coding turned into a social experience—no coding required.

products.name: Flappy Bid
products.tagline: The leaderboard money can't buy
products.summaryZh: 排行榜上的金钱是买不到的。
products.descriptionZh: 广告平台把顶部位置卖给付费最高者。FlappyBid则把它交给玩得最好的人。输入你的产品，玩Flappy Bird，不限次数。UTC时间00:00，得分最高的产品将拥有整个网站24小时，附带实时点击计数器，然后以不败战绩退役。
products.description: Ad platforms sell the top spot to whoever pays most. FlappyBid gives it to whoever plays best. Enter your product, play Flappy Bird, unlimited runs. At 00:00 UTC the top product owns the whole site for 24h with a live click counter, then retires undefeated.

products.name: roastme.gg
products.tagline: Get roasted. Publicly.
products.summaryZh: 公开接受吐槽。
products.descriptionZh: 付费让AI公开吐槽你。留下你的X账号或网站，选择伤害程度（从1美元到1000美元以上的焦土级别），Claude仅凭名字和给人的感觉来写吐槽，不参考个人简介、帖子或任何抓取信息。每条吐槽都会按支付金额排名，出现在公开排行榜上，并附带一张可分享到X的卡片。
products.description: Pay to get publicly roasted by AI. Drop your X handle or a website, pick how hard it should hurt ($1 to a $1,000+ scorched-earth tier), and Claude writes a roast based on nothing but the name and the vibe it gives off, no bio, no posts, no scraping. Every roast lands on a public leaderboard ranked by price paid, with a shareable card for X.

products.name: Cognitive Biases Academy
products.tagline: Free, 66 languages, one goal: a billion self-aware minds
products.summaryZh: 免费，66种语言，一个目标：十亿个自觉意识。
products.descriptionZh: 你的大脑天生就会出错：确切地说，有190多种方式。认知偏见学院是一个免费的图书馆和课程，用平实的语言涵盖所有有记录的偏见：它从何而来，如何扭曲你的决策，以及如何在自己身上发现它。基于1800多篇学术参考文献，翻译成66种语言，永久免费，无需信用卡。使命：让十亿人能够察觉自己思维出错。科学表明，我们中的10%就足以影响其余的人。成为那10%的一部分。
products.description: Your brain misfires by design: 190+ ways, to be exact. Cognitive Biases Academy is a free library and course covering every documented bias in plain language: where it comes from, how it distorts your decisions, and how to catch it in yourself. Backed by 1,800+ academic references, translated into 66 languages, free forever, no card required. The mission: one billion people who can catch their own thinking going wrong. Science says 10% of us is enough to tip the rest. Be part of the 10%.

products.name: Canned Web
products.tagline: Lock a Mac to one website. Kiosk mode. No MDM
products.summaryZh: 将Mac锁定到单一网站。信息亭模式。无需MDM。
products.descriptionZh: macOS没有内置的kiosk模式。Canned Web将Mac锁定在一个网站上，全屏显示。Spotlight、Cmd-Tab和截图功能被禁用，锁定在你的域名内，只有输入密码才能退出。非常适合产品演示、展会摊位、标牌和展览。一次性收费49欧元，无需MDM。
products.description: macOS has no built-in kiosk mode. Canned Web locks a Mac to one website, fullscreen. Spotlight, Cmd-Tab and screenshots blocked, locked to your domain, exit only with a password. Great for product demos, trade-show booths, signage and exhibits. One-time €49, no MDM.

products.name: Mugmoji
products.tagline: Turn any photo into an animated Slack emoji. Free.
products.summaryZh: 将任意照片转换为动态Slack表情符号。免费。
products.descriptionZh: 上传一张照片。Mugmoji自动去除背景，你从73种动态预设中选择，它便会导出一张已按Slack的128KB表情符号限制调整大小并压缩的GIF动图。免费，无需账户，无需安装。完全在浏览器中运行。
products.description: Upload a photo. Mugmoji cuts out the background, you pick from 73 motion presets, and it exports an animated GIF already sized and compressed for Slack's 128KB emoji limit. Free, no account, nothing to install. Runs entirely in your browser.

products.name: Gemini for Students
products.tagline: Introducing 1 Year Free Google AI for College Students
products.summaryZh: 为大学生推出谷歌AI一年免费使用
products.descriptionZh: 提升你的学术工作流程效率。谷歌现面向全球符合条件的大学生，免费提供为期一年的Google AI Pro或Google AI Plus，并配套Gemini内全新推出的学生中心。立即访问gemini.google.com/students，领取你的12个月免费使用权！
products.description: Supercharge your academic workflow. Google is offering eligible college students worldwide 1 full year of Google AI Pro or Google AI Plus at no cost, paired with an all-new Student Hub inside Gemini. Claim your 12-month free access today at gemini.google.com/students!

products.name: Quick RSS
products.tagline: Private RSS Reader
products.summaryZh: 私有RSS阅读器
products.descriptionZh: Quick RSS是一款易于使用、注重隐私且直观的桌面RSS阅读器。无论您是新闻爱好者，还是喜欢关注博客文章和头条的人，Quick RSS都能帮助您轻松管理和阅读喜爱的RSS订阅源。
products.description: Quick RSS is an easy-to-use, private, and intuitive desktop RSS reader. Whether you're a news enthusiast or someone who likes to follow blog posts and headlines, Quick RSS helps you effortlessly manage and read your favorite RSS feeds.

products.name: First Verse
products.tagline: The best new poems, written by real people
products.summaryZh: 由真实作者创作的最新优秀诗作
products.descriptionZh: First Verse是每日发现最佳新诗的地方；由真实的人创作和朗读。发布你自己的作品，在收件箱中获取热门诗歌，并给其他诗人打赏。
products.description: First Verse is the place to find the best new poems every day; written and read by real people. Post your own work, get popular poems in your inbox, and tip other poets.
